subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers split and retire this broad field-report issue now, or keep it open as the umbrella tracker until every historical slice is fixed, rejected, or separately tracked?
rationale: The issue spans mature config, Gateway, Discord, cron, setup, update, and resource-policy surfaces; current main proves partial fixes but not complete closure, so the remaining choice is maintainer issue hygiene and product-scope routing rather than a single code verdict.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Link the unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, preserve this report as evidence, and close it once the durable trackers are complete.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad field report while maintainers continue using it to audit unresolved production-use findings.

options.title: Close as superseded now
options.body: Close this issue with links to the strongest active canonical issues, accepting that weaker slices need fresh focused reports if they recur.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Link the unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, preserve this report as evidence, and close it once the durable trackers are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is cross-surface product routing and issue hygiene, and this person has the broadest observed history across config docs, cron docs, and Discord-adjacent work.
